The node appears to be shifting from generic data-center square footage toward pre-qualified, repeatable reference architectures combining liquid cooling, power distribution, controls, battery/UPS/grid interaction and lifecycle services.

node: Data-center thermal management and on-site power distribution stack
summary: Layer 1B expansion found five US-listed candidates with direct or adjacent exposure to the AI data-center thermal and on-site power stack: Vertiv as the broadest integrated power/cooling platform, Eaton as the electrical power-distribution and newly expanded thermal-components platform, Trane Technologies as a high-capacity liquid-cooling and chiller/thermal-reference-design supplier, nVent as a rack/liquid-cooling/power-distribution component supplier embedded in NVIDIA DSX-related reference architecture, and Modine as a less-obvious but increasingly direct data-center cooling capacity supplier through Airedale. The chokepoint logic is strongest where companies show AI-specific liquid cooling, CDU, rack-density, power-distribution, backlog/order, or reserved-capacity evidence rather than generic HVAC or construction exposure.
